cause_quote: The original restore code rejected a saved source when `generationOwner.requiredGeneration !== snapshot.sharedGeneration`, so changing a proxy admission header invalidated the source even when the operator's grant was still current.
user_saw: After a trusted-proxy admission setting changed, affected automations failed on their next run and were automatically disabled.
summary: The fix uses the saved operator grant to restore proxy-authenticated automations and retains exact generation checks for shared credentials and OpenClaw ID tunnel sources.
reasoning: I checked the original recovery diff and verified that trusted-proxy sign-ins already carried a generation that included `requiredHeaders`, so an admission-only change could invalidate recovery from the start. PR #176422 later routed saved cron authority through that same restore check, so automations inherited the defect when that feature shipped.
